subject: Re: Parallax Systems — synthesis & proposed next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@parallax.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.s@parallax.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Parallax discovery — synthesis & proposed next steps

Alec / Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick synthesis of what we heard and a proposed next-step plan so everyone is aligned. If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update.

Key pain & goals (what you said):
- Production latency spikes and unpredictable token costs on peak inference loads (engineering pain).
- Need a predictable SLA for support and data isolation for regulated PII workflows (security/compliance).
- Reduce per-endpoint unit cost by ~30% while keeping latency within 150–200ms p95 for 512-token workloads (business goal).

What we propose / immediate scope:
1) 4-week trial (hosted) with two representative endpoints: customer-support summarization and in-product code-assist.
   - Success metrics: p95 latency <= 200ms, unit cost <= $0.XX/token (we’ll fill final figure in the quote), model quality parity vs your baseline on our eval set.
2) Dedicated pilot runbook if trial meets KPIs: reserved capacity slice + canary rollout to 10% traffic.
3) Security items: provide SOC2 evidence, KMS integration steps, and an isolated VPC option if needed for the dedicated phase.

Milestones & tentative schedule (subject to your sign-off):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange scope & test data samples (you + engineering).
- Week 1: Redwood spins up trial endpoints + test harness.
- Week 2: Run synthetic and live tests; collect latency/cost telemetry.
- Week 3: Joint review; decide go/no-go for dedicated slice.

Owners (proposed):
- Parallax: Alec (product lead) / Priya (security)
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) / Ben (Sales Director) / Jasmine (SE)

Attachments: I’ve included a short SOW outline and a preliminary trial quote for internal review.

Next actions (this week):
- Alec: share sample payloads and a small test dataset (by Tue).
- Priya: let us know your SOC2 / vendor assessment timeline and any required contacts.
- Ben / Jasmine: we’ll prepare a test plan + onboarding doc and follow up with scheduling.

Thanks again — available for a quick sync if you want to walk through the SOW together.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: parallax_sow_outline.pdf (outline, 2 pages); redwood_trial_quote.xlsx (estimates)

From: Alec Turner <alec.turner@parallax.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@parallax.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Parallax discovery — synthesis & proposed next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear write-up, this captures the call well. A couple clarifications from our side: 

1) Our latency objective is 95th percentile <= 180ms for the code-assist endpoint; the 200ms cap is acceptable for summarization.
2) Cost target: we’re expecting an absolute ceiling rather than a percentage — I’ll confirm a hard $/token cap by Monday.
3) For SOC2: we have an internal vendor questionnaire that Priya will share. We also usually request a short architecture diagram for data flow.

We can provide a small sample of anonymized support tickets and 500 code snippets by Tue EOD. Priya — can you share the vendor questionnaire as a start?

One ask from me: can Redwood run the trial in our preferred region (us-east-1)? If not, recommend indicating expected added latency.

I’m looping in our Eng lead, Sam Ortega, on the next email thread for payload details.

—Alec
Alec Turner
Director, Product — Parallax Systems
alec.turner@parallax.com | (202) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: Parallax trial prep (sync)

Marissa / Jasmine — quick internal note before we reply with confirmations. Thoughts below: 

- Region: confirm hosted trial in us-east-1 to match their ask. We can try to route to a nearby pool; need to call out estimated p95 delta in the SOW.
- Telemetry: Jasmine, can you prepare the evaluation harness we used for the Helix pilot? Adapt it for the two endpoints and include 512-token and 64-token distributions.
- Legal/compliance: we’ll flag the SOC2 evidence and draft a short architecture diagram. Possible redline: VPC option gated behind dedicated stage.

I’ll take the pricing alignment on the quote and push a clean number by EOD Monday so Alec has something concrete.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Priya Sethi <priya.s@parallax.com>

Marissa — appreciate the concise plan. I’ve attached our vendor questionnaire and our security lead Sam will add the architecture diagram.

We’re good to proceed with the trial in us-east-1. Expect the samples to land by Tue. Also confirming compliance: our procurement team will require a standard DPA and an initial SLA note for the pilot (nothing legal-binding yet, just to speed procurement).

I’ll follow up with the SOC2 doc and the questionnaire in a separate email (attachments).

Thanks,
Priya Sethi
Head of Information Security | Parallax Systems
priya.s@parallax.com
